name: swgsurvivors-patcher-csharp
description: C# version of SWGSurvivors Delta Patcher

scripts.build and deploy: npm run clean && npm run build && npm run move
scripts.create github version tag: node -e "const readline = require('readline').createInterface({input: process.stdin, output: process.stdout}); readline.question('Enter tag (e.g., v0.2.1): ', tag => { if (!tag) { console.error('Tag required'); process.exit(1); } require('child_process').execSync(`git tag ${tag} && git push origin main && git push origin ${tag}`, {stdio: 'inherit'}); readline.close(); })"
scripts.build: dotnet publish -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained true -p:PublishSingleFile=true -p:IncludeNativeLibrariesForSelfExtract=true -p:EnableCompressionInSingleFile=true -o publish
scripts.clean: if exist bin rmdir /s /q bin && if exist obj rmdir /s /q obj && if exist publish rmdir /s /q publish
scripts.rebuild: npm run clean && npm run build

author: Quandru
